objective: Replace the compliance-filtered 1,216-row plugin directory with a category-first, listing-state view over every record in the current dsh.so public index, while preserving existing DSH STORE Catalog/candidate records not present in that snapshot.

dataSource.scope: Read-only public index metadata. No third-party code execution, security/compatibility/compliance screening, Catalog admission, or install action.

mutation.rollback: Revert the feature commit; the prior Catalog and candidate registries remain untouched and Git history retains the previous directory.

deterministicGates: Source index JSON count equals its plugins array length and all 19,345 source rows are preserved exactly once in the generated snapshot; malformed rows receive safe fallbacks rather than being screened out.
Directory includes all source snapshot rows plus unmatched Catalog and Candidate Registry records; no DSH-topic or compliance predicate removes rows.
Categories derive only from public topic/capability tags with an explicit Uncategorized bucket; categories are the primary navigation dimension and collected/uncollected is a separate filter.
Collected means a matching record exists in the DSH STORE Catalog; this is not an installability, compatibility, security, or policy verdict. The directory renders no installation command/action.
Attribution and source generatedAt are preserved in data and displayed on the site; no claim that the snapshot is live is made.
A disposable fixture with at least 12,000 records verifies lossless population, category filtering, collection-state filtering, deduplication behavior, pagination, and no install actions.
Update the storefront contract assertion to require the category-directory loader, rather than the retired candidate-only loader.
Run npm run check and static-build verification; inspect a local browser route with the full snapshot and confirm loading always resolves or shows a bounded error/retry state.
